local.python:
import asyncio
import websockets


async def main():
    url = "wss://192.168.0.1/proxy/protect/integration/v1/subscribe/devices"
    headers = {
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "X-API-Key": "<X-API-Key>",
    }
    async with websockets.connect(url, additional_headers=headers) as ws:
        async for message in ws:
            print(message)


asyncio.run(main())
